summary: Group variables apply a value to all hosts in a group, via [group:vars] in INI or vars: in YAML. Ansible flattens all variables to host level, merging values from all a host's groups by internal rules.
questions: How do I set a variable for all hosts in a group?
What happens when a host's groups define the same variable differently?

answer_card.title: Group variables
answer_card.answer_md:
INI:
```ini
[atlanta:vars]
ntp_server=ntp.atlanta.example.com
```
YAML:
```yaml
atlanta:
  hosts: {host1: , host2: }
  vars:
    ntp_server: ntp.atlanta.example.com
```
Before running, Ansible flattens variables to each host. If a host is in several groups that set the same variable, internal merge rules pick the value.
